Read a Risk Register from Disk

Source: R/risk_register_io.R
read_risk_register.Rd

Imports a risk register previously written by write_risk_register() (or any compatible CSV / xlsx carrying at least risk_id and description) and rebuilds it through create_risk_register(). The canonical schema, RPN, and risk-level classification are therefore reconstructed from the assessed scores rather than trusted from the file, so an imported register is always internally consistent.

Usage

read_risk_register(path, config = risk_config_default())

Arguments

path

Input file path. A .xlsx extension reads an Excel workbook (requires the readxl package); any other extension reads CSV.

config

A risk_config from risk_config_default(), forwarded to create_risk_register() for RPN classification.

Value

A tibble of class "risk_register".

See also

write_risk_register() for the inverse, create_risk_register().

Examples

rr <- create_risk_register(data.frame(
  risk_id       = c("R001", "R002"),
  description   = c("Missing vars", "Bad derivation"),
  probability   = c(4, 2),
  impact        = c(5, 3),
  detectability = c(2, 3)
))
path <- file.path(tempdir(), "risk_register.csv")
write_risk_register(rr, path)
rr2 <- read_risk_register(path)
identical(rr$rpn, rr2$rpn)
#> [1] TRUE
unlink(path)
